items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1959-01-13
items.q: And they had another drummer they called Edie Chandler. And Edie Chandler, he couldn't play unless he was half high.

ctx.x: Yeah, the smallest you can remember, as far back as you can remember. Who were the best drummers in the old days?
Well, the best drummers was Cantrap. And they had another drummer they called Edie Chandler.
